221366115_a1ffbab6.text: The ICMs are small cell clusters and consist of more dopamine type-1 and µ-opioid-receptor expressing cells (Poulin et al., 2008).
221366115_a1ffbab6.section: Classical neuron classes across amygdala subdivisions

221366115_197a5821.text: The majority of BLA neurons are spiny glutamatergic neurons (with a minority of GABAergic interneurons) (Spampanato et al., 2011). CEl and CEm mainly contain GABAergic neurons.
